column1: # Arch makedepends name <TAB> Debian package(s) that provide the build tool or headers.
# Read only by packages/pkgbuild2deb, before the main map: at build time "qt6-base" means its headers.
# Libraries: an Arch library package carries its headers, Debian splits them into -dev. A recipe's depends= are
# installed from here before building; the package's run-time library dependencies are then worked out from
# the built binaries by dpkg-shlibdeps, so run-time library names need no map at all.
